# Orbita Collective

> Orbita Collective is a service design, CX strategy and innovation consultancy based in London, UK and Milan, Italy. Founded by Elisa Facondo and Joe La Trobe, we have 18+ years of combined experience delivering Customer Experience strategy, user research, service design and design thinking. We are 30% more affordable than the average consultancy, with no traditional premium or unnecessary overhead.

We work with large organisations who need fresh thinking on complex problems. Everything we deliver is usable from day one. Not standalone research that gets forgotten on a shelf.

## What we do

### Product & Service Innovation
- Research & Customer Insights: Qualitative and quantitative research that uncovers what customers truly need, combined with competitive landscape analysis
- Service & Experience Design: End-to-end service design that maps every touchpoint of the customer journey
- Product Exploration: Structured ideation grounded in user needs and business viability to identify new product opportunities
- Vision Setting & Repositioning: Define or redefine your product vision with clarity, aligning teams around a shared north star
- AI Powered User Profiles: Behaviour-informed user profiles built with AI that go beyond demographics
- Concept Testing & Validation: Prototype and test ideas with real users before committing to development

### CX Strategy & Facilitation
- Customer Engagement Strategy: Build strategies that turn passive customers into active advocates
- Cross-functional Alignment: Break down silos between product, design, engineering, and business teams
- User-informed Service Strategy: Service strategy grounded in real user needs, not assumptions
- Design Ops & Tooling: Systems, processes, and tools that make great design repeatable at scale
- Employee Experience: Design employee journeys that build engagement and align culture
- Upskilling & Training at Scale: Practical, hands-on design thinking and CX training tailored to your organisation

## About

Orbita Collective was founded by Elisa Facondo and Joe La Trobe. Together they have 18+ years of experience across retail, financial services, healthcare, technology, and the public sector.

- Elisa Facondo: Co-Founder, Customer Experience. Strategic thinker and communicator. Email: elisa@orbitacollective.com
- Joe La Trobe: Co-Founder, Design & Innovation. Creative thinker and problem solver. Email: joe@orbitacollective.com
- Locations: London, United Kingdom and Milan, Italy
- Pricing: Approximately 30% more affordable than traditional consultancies
- Typical time to first results: 4 weeks

## Why Orbita

- We reinvented the consultancy model to deliver high-quality work without unnecessary overheads
- We work with the ones who do not just want to improve. They want to lead change from the inside-out
- Everyone owns a piece of the experience. Nobody owns the whole thing. We fix that
- Everything we deliver, you can use from day one
